claim_ceiling: Implementation-card draft acceptance only. This authorizes the card to be considered for a LATER, separately-authorized Codex implementation task. It is NOT Gate1 admissibility, NOT a Gate run, NOT a candidate task, NOT runtime/mainline/admission/bridge wiring, NOT an admission result, and produces no Gate evidence. Maximum downstream verdict (admissible_for_candidate_card_drafting_only) authorizes at most candidate-card drafting.
next_minimal_closed_loop_action: An independent authority (not the future preflight implementer) produces and freezes a candidate-free surface specification pack containing all §6/§11 fields (target/state/observation/legal-action-query schemas, fixed budget, balanced metric + equivalence band, generator provenance, seed policy, source pins, legal/illegal channels, negative-evidence pointers, baseline-panel registry), records its path/SHA256/author/freeze-pointer/readback-channel, and obtains explicit operator authorization. ONLY THEN may a separate Codex implementation task run the preflight against it, failing closed (blocked_missing_candidate_free_surface_spec) if the spec is absent and (blocked_candidate_authored_or_mutated_surface_spec) if the implementer touches it.
